mission.title: A Little R & D
mission.description: Convince the Exile Abanderada to help develop a portable EMCP device.

npc.say: What are you waiting for? Bring me Ether's head, and I will join your research efforts.

phase.briefing:
You know, {player}, it's lucky I hold you in such high esteem. Some of your friends are still busy with their little delivery tasks, but I have something a little more interesting in mind for you.
I assume you remember the EMCP device which I invented? Some details must have lodged themselves somewhere in your tiny brain, somewhere? No matter. What is important is this: Following up on my brilliant discovery, the Merovingian's scientists are working to miniaturize it. Imagine, a device you can carry with you, that will disable those foolish commandos instantly... You are forced to admit my genius, I am afraid.
Now, we're going to need the help of a specific Exile, named Abanderada. He hasn't agreed to help yet. This is where you come in. Go talk to him. Do whatever it takes to convince him.

enter.say: All right, Abanderada should be in here somewhere. You heard Flood, do whatever it takes.

talk.say:
Oh, all right, all right. Stop this foolishness. I know who you've been sent by. I even know why you're here.
An EMCP device, a portable one? Very intriguing. I could very well help you develop this. The General's commandos have caused me no end of trouble, I can assure you.
But first, I want some payment in advance. A guarantee of your good will, if you prefer. There is an Exile named Ether. You need know nothing of the history between he and I, save the extent of my hatred. I want his head.
No, wait... on second thought, just kill him. I just always wanted to say that.

done.say: I would have you kill Abanderada, or break his fingers... but the Merovingian needs him alive, and intact. Get out of there and I'll give you directions to Ether.

near.say: Okay, what does the old Merovingian rulebook say about this situation... Oh yeah, of course. Kill the guards.

phase.briefing: Follow the little green circles and kill Ether. You can manage that, can't you?

enter.say: You heard Flood. Take Ether down, clean and simple.

done.say: Ether's down. Time to get out of here.

phase.briefing: Abanderada is going to meet us at a safe location. He'll need an escort from there to one of our labs... apparently he's a feeling a little anxious with no guards to watch him.

talk.say: I hope, for your sake, that you can keep me safe, {player}.
Well? Are we going or not?

objective.text: Lead Abanderada out of the area

phase.briefing: All right, now just keep him alive until you reach the safe zone. You'll be dropping him with one of our scientists, Dr. Ivkovic.

enter.say: All right, looks like you made it. Just drop him with Dr. Ivkovic and you can be on your way.

near.say: The Merovingian told us you would be coming, {player}. Is Abanderada with you?

complete.say: I have much to discuss with Abanderada. I wonder, will we be able to overcome the multiple polarization issue? Will we?
Gee, thanks. Looks like Ivkovic is going to be more fun than a barrel of monkeys.

mission.finish:
Once again, my favorite lackey finishes the mission. Well, favorite is such a strong word...
We'll be in touch, {player}.
